description: Name the country from its flag emoji — 65 flags in multiple-choice format with streak scoring.

faqs.a: 65 countries from every continent, asked in random order without repeats.
Each question shows the flag and 4 country options. Correct answers score 10 plus a streak bonus.
A wrong answer resets your streak but you keep playing through all 65 flags.
faqs.q: What happens on a wrong answer?

faqs.a: Yes — flags range from easy to genuinely tricky ones.

howto: Pick the correct country from 4 options.
Build a streak for bonus points.
title: Emoji Flag Guessing Game
